name: Republic of Korea
tso_role: Market + system operator (TSO function); transmission assets owned by KEPCO
tso_ownership: KPX non-profit under MOTIE (Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy)
transmission_asset_owner: KEPCO — Korea Electric Power Corporation (majority government-owned)
dso_ownership: Government majority (Korea Development Bank + Korean state)
dso_count_note: SINGLE-DSO MONOPOLY — cohort-UNIQUE first. All ~25M LV customer connections under one operator. Architectural flag triggers single-DSO rendering on dno-dashboard.html.
regulator: KOREC — Korea Electricity Regulation Commission (under MOTIE)
cert_parent: KISA — Korea Internet & Security Agency (한국인터넷진흥원, under MSIT)
nis2_law: Act on the Protection of Information and Communications Infrastructure (정보통신기반보호법) — original 2001, multiple amendments
nis2_competent_authority: MSIT (Ministry of Science & ICT) + NIS (National Intelligence Service) coordinating
voltage_class_note: Korea operates 765 kV ultra-high voltage transmission backbone (Hanul → Sinjincheon switching stations) — UNIQUE in OECD coverage. 154 kV is the dominant sub-transmission class (61% of fleet).
frequency_note: Korean Peninsula 60Hz unified. Cohort-UNIQUE — all other onboarded countries are 50Hz (except JP which is 50Hz east + 60Hz west split).
comment_methodological_notes: Korea is an ISOLATED grid — ZERO cross-border interconnects. DPRK link cut since Korean War armistice 1953. Renderer + dno-dashboard must handle empty cross_border_lines arrays gracefully. Display '0 MW (isolated peninsula)' rather than '—' or 'no data'. Validates Iceland (IS Session 30) isolated-grid pattern in Asian context.

Korea is SINGLE-DSO monopoly (KEPCO) — cohort-UNIQUE first. dno-dashboard.html should render a single-DSO panel (not the typical 3-6 DSO panel). The dno_count field flagging this is the new architectural test for Korea Session 31.

Korea is 60Hz peninsular unified — cohort-UNIQUE (all other onboarded countries 50Hz except JP 50/60Hz split). 60Hz affects τ_sync calibration (lower per-MW inertia constant); documented in scoring-kr/modifiers/inertia.py.

Korea has 24 NPPs operational — highest count in OECD coverage. S3 'Nuclear-Critical' subclass added (parallel to IS S3-Aluminum, JP S3-Nuclear). Critical-cluster sites: Kori (Busan border + S. Gyeongsang), Hanbit (S. Jeolla — Yeonggwang), Hanul (N. Gyeongsang — Uljin), Wolsong (N. Gyeongsang — Gyeongju).
ISO 9223 C5 corrosion RESTORED for Korea (like IS Session 30). Peninsula = full marine coast. C5 applies to: Jeju + S. Jeolla coast + S. Gyeongsang coast + Busan + Pohang coast + Gangwon east coast.

R6_typhoon is a NEW sub-pattern introduced for Korea — Pacific corridor exposure. Anchor events: Typhoon Hinnamnor (6 Sep 2022, 66,000+ households lost power, Geoje landfall), Typhoon Khanun (10 Aug 2023, 40,350 lost power, west coast), Typhoon Bolaven (Aug 2012, Jeju historical base rate). Generalisable to next-cohort Pacific countries.

R6_chaebol is a NEW sub-pattern introduced for Korea — fab-cluster concentration. Samsung Pyeongtaek + SK Hynix Icheon + LG Paju semiconductor corridors (Gyeonggi α=0.08). Ulsan + S. Jeolla Gwangyang steel + N. Gyeongsang Pohang steel (α=0.07). Magnitude-of-impact = chaebol single-site catastrophic; differs from IS R6_volcanic (probability-based) or HU R3 (consequence-weighted).

Pohang 2017 Mw 5.5 earthquake — anchor for R6_seismic N. Gyeongsang α=0.10. ANTHROPOGENICALLY INDUCED — EGS geothermal hydraulic injection triggered fault rupture (Grigoli et al. 2018 Science). Largest + most damaging in modern KR history. Korean court 2019 found project responsible.

Currency is KRW (₩) with pre-symbol convention ('₩1,000' not '1,000 ₩'). Korean OECD member since 1996-12-12 (29th member). Cohort-UNIQUE in Asia-only OECD position (vs JP 1964 founding-Asia, IS 1961 founding-EU, HU 1996 same-year).

KEPCO operator multi-naming requires normalization: Korean OSM entries appear as 한국전력공사 (full Korean) + KEPCO (English) + 한국전력 (abbreviated) + branch-suffixed variants (e.g., 한국전력공사 성남전력지사). Handled in scoring-kr normalizer with operator-canonical dict.

Korean OSM coverage is structurally lower than European cohort peers — Naver/Kakao maps dominate Korean cartography over OSM. MIN_FLEET[KR]=800 (~67% of actual 1,184) reflects this; not a quality concern, just lower mapping density.

KISA + KrCERT/CC founded 2001 → 25-year cyber-incident catalogue (cohort-leading by years). NIS2-equivalent regime via Act on the Protection of Information and Communications Infrastructure since 2001-12-26. R7 ceiling 1.015 reflects this mature cyber regime (lower than SI 1.04, SK 1.03, IS 1.04 — cohort-LOWEST R7 ceiling).

r6_chaebol_methodology.rationale: Korean chaebol industrial concentration is structurally different from European cohort: single-site catastrophic loss potential exceeds even Iceland aluminum corridor (3 sites total) — Samsung Pyeongtaek alone consumes more electricity than several Korean provinces. R6_chaebol captures this magnitude-of-impact (vs R6_volcanic probability-based, vs R3 consequence-weighted general).
